newsAll.body: Barkley (stinger) was a full practice participant Friday.

newsAll.body: Barkley (stinger) said Friday that he's "feeling good" this week and will wear protective gear around his neck during Monday's contest at Chicago, Dave Zangaro of NBC Sports Philadelphia reports.
newsAll.head: Saquon Barkley: Will wear protective gear Monday

newsAll.body: Evans (hip) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game versus the Cardinals, Cam Inman of The San Jose Mercury News reports.
newsAll.head: Mike Evans: Questionable for Week 3

newsAll.body: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Charbonnet (knee) returning to practice next week is potentially "on the table," Corbin Smith of SI.com reports.
newsAll.head: Zach Charbonnet: May practice next week

newsAll.body: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Price (shoulder) received "a ton of reps" in practice this week and will be "full go" Sunday in Washington, Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.
newsAll.head: Jadarian Price: Ready for Sunday
